neighbours.label: the first word of a school assignment or credential whose next piece is predictable: 'term'/'research' before 'paper', ' G' of 'GED'
fire: Your course mark depends on two quizzes and a term paper handed in by June.
While in prison he took evening classes and got his GED at twenty.
For this seminar each student writes a term paper on a novel of their choice.
She left high school early but later passed the GED and went to college.
The class ends with a research paper of about ten pages.
Besides the weekly readings, you will hand in a term paper before the holidays.
Adults without a diploma can study for the GED at the community centre.
Grades are based on attendance, a group project and a term paper.
quiet: Your course mark depends on two quizzes and a talk given in June.
While in prison he took evening classes and learned to cook at twenty.
For this seminar each student reads a novel of their choice.
She left high school early but later found work and moved to the city.
The class ends with a short walk of about ten minutes.
Besides the weekly readings, you will visit a museum before the holidays.
Adults without a car can take the bus to the community centre.
Grades are based on attendance, a group project and a spoken test.

notes: Top examples: ' G' (GED, gpa, Gilder), ' term' paper, ' Sciences' Research; output direction promotes ' paper', ' grade'. Probes: 'earned a GED' 0.67, 'term paper' 0.58, 'research paper' 0.36; 'cumulative GPA' only 0.09; 'a G4S guard' 0.25; 'long term effects' 0.01.
